reason: A torched-meringue hot chocolate and a strawberry cheesecake matcha right at my subway exit are exactly the kind of thing I'd try once and post. But on my budget it's a treat for content, not a daily swap for the coffee place I already go to.
objection: $7.50 is a lot for me, and once I've posted the pretty ones I don't see why I'd keep paying that instead of my usual cheaper coffee.
would_change_my_mind: A new drink of the week that actually looks different each week, or a cheaper small size of the signature drinks, would get me back more often.
